# Changelog

## [v0.1.1] - 2026-10-09

### Added

- Added ordered multi-track audiobook assembly with chapters, metadata, cover art, verification, and reusable manifests
- Added read-only profile preflight and output resolution APIs that validate selected resources and encoders before export

### Documentation

- Documented CLI, profiles, audiobooks, APIs, and migration workflows in Sphinx

## [v0.1.0] - 2026-10-09

### Added

- Added standalone FFmpeg export API and CLI for seven formats with metadata, chapters, cover art, and manifests

### Changed

- Changed exports with multi-format profiles, diagnostics, transactional recovery, writer locking, and release checks
- Improved OGG exports with a native Vorbis encoder fallback when libvorbis is unavailable
